description: CTO BACKUP DURABILITY V2 §A.4/§B: the operational-state export (odg-state-backup) writes a FIXED path and OVERWRITES the previous archive ⇒ no immutable history, and a crash mid-write could destroy the last good archive. Fix (bounded, both ports): write DISTINCT timestamped IMMUTABLE snapshots (<out>/snapshots/<createdAtMs>-<hash8>/), protected against overwrite (refuse a differing-content collision; idempotent on identical content), with ATOMIC writes (tmp+rename) and a `latest.json` pointer updated atomically. Read-only source + fail-closed + secret-scan + symlink-skip (already verified) preserved. No new primitive; reuses client-store-backup verify/restore unchanged.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION V2 — BACKUP DURABILITY, GIT TRUTH LOCK & RECOVERY READINESS §A.4/§B (immutable timestamped snapshots, overwrite-protected).

work_item_contract.objective: doExport writes an immutable timestamped snapshot (<out>/snapshots/<createdAtMs>-<hash8>/{manifest.json,summary.json}), atomically (tmp+rename); refuses to overwrite an existing snapshot whose content differs (SNAPSHOT_COLLISION); idempotent on identical content; updates <out>/latest.json atomically. verify/restore unchanged (take a manifest path). Deterministic given --now.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: REPRODUCED: doExport writes DEFAULT_OUT/manifest.json (fixed) ⇒ a second export overwrites the first; no history; non-atomic write ⇒ a crash can leave a corrupt/absent archive. ROOT CAUSE: single fixed output path + non-atomic write. PLAN: distinct immutable timestamped snapshots + atomic tmp+rename + collision guard + latest pointer.
work_item_contract.scope: odg-state-backup both ports: doExport snapshot layout + atomic write + collision guard + latest pointer; a small snapshotDir/atomicWrite helper. verify/restore + exportState (manifest builder) + secret-scan + symlink-skip UNCHANGED. Extend the test. Update the doc.
invariants: IMMUTABLE: an existing snapshot is NEVER overwritten with differing content (SNAPSHOT_COLLISION refusal); identical content ⇒ idempotent ok.
ATOMIC: manifest/summary/latest written via tmp+rename (no partial-write corruption of a good archive).
Distinct snapshots per export (timestamp+hash) ⇒ history preserved; a new export never destroys a prior one.
Read-only source + fail-closed + SECRET_DETECTED + symlink-skip + dangerous-path guards UNCHANGED.
Reuse client-store-backup verify/restore (no duplicated integrity logic; no new primitive).
Full archive stays gitignored; git keeps tool/tests/doc/summary only.
Preserve the 5 stashes, worktree, boussole, research; delete/overwrite no existing data (incl. the prior flat archive — left in place).
acceptance_criteria: Two exports with DIFFERENT content ⇒ two distinct snapshot dirs (both verifiable, neither overwritten); same content+same --now ⇒ idempotent (same dir, ok); a collision with differing content at the same dir ⇒ SNAPSHOT_COLLISION refusal (prior snapshot intact); latest.json points at the newest; atomic (no leftover .tmp); read-only source; dual-port parity; non-regression of the existing 19 assertions. tsc 0. LIVE: a new snapshot created without clobbering the prior flat archive; verify+restore-to-sandbox from the snapshot == source. Diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: A snapshot would overwrite differing prior content; source would be mutated; a path outside the write-set is needed.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.ts runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.js runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.test.ts docs/operational-backup.md ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/missions/OPERATIONAL_BACKUP_SNAPSHOTS.json; npm run build:runtime.
evidence_required: distinct-snapshots + collision-refusal + idempotent + latest-pointer + atomic test

objectives.goal: Immutable timestamped overwrite-protected atomic snapshots + latest pointer in odg-state-backup; durability preserved; both ports; proven test + live.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set; live snapshot proven.

definition_of_done: odg-state-backup writes immutable, timestamped, overwrite-protected, atomic snapshots (+ latest pointer) so a new export never destroys a prior archive; read-only/fail-closed/secret/symlink guards intact; both ports; proven test + live; committed (no force). A durability fix, no new primitive.
